1844-03-21.editor: J. M'Gonagle. His valedictory is in this paper.
on_the_ground: Mahood & Grimes, old Hogg and Wood stand.
Miss Sarah Ritchey, milliner, Steubenville street, opposite John Beall's Drug Store.
John Selby farm, Cadiz township, joining George Day and John Hines, offered for sale.
1844-03-21.why: First issue in this 1844 run. Next Thursday L. Harper is in the chair.

on_the_ground: Western Exchange: A. P. Croskey, stand formerly Thos. D. Grimes.
Stanton and Peppard (E. M. Stanton, S. G. Peppard), opposite James McNutt's Hotel.
P. R. K. Brotherson, corner of Market and Steubenville, opposite the public buildings.
1844-03-28.why: Harper's first week as editor in this run. The hotel and the lawyers take their stands on the square.

on_the_ground: Samuel Timmons, saddle and harness, corner brick opposite Hogg's old stand.
Crabb and Roberts, tailors, opposite Kilgore and Co.
Cummins and Harper, office on Steubenville street, opposite the public buildings.
1844-04-04.why: More of the square fills in: the saddler, the tailors, the law office on Steubenville street.

on_the_ground: J. W. Beebe and Co., cheap store, opposite the treasurer's office.
Miss Jane Scott, milliner, New Athens, Maine street, house of Mrs. Grimes. Franklin College is in the paper this spring.
1844-04-11.why: The treasurer's corner gets a cheap store. New Athens is on the same map as Cadiz this week.

on_the_ground: Rea & Eaton (John Rea, David Eaton), boots and shoes, opposite the Jail Buildings, immediately under the Sentinel office.
A. S. Canfield, Variety Store, one door west of Thomas Hogg's old stand, room formerly George Craig.
1844-04-18.why: The press and the jail share a wall. The shoe shop sits immediately under the Sentinel.

on_the_ground: T. and W. Hamilton, boots and shoes, opposite the public buildings, old stand of Thomas Phillips.
I. Eckelson, tailor, opposite Hogg and Tipton's store, room formerly Miss Bowles's milliner shop.
1844-04-25.why: Two more doors on the square: Hamilton at Phillips’s old stand, Eckelson in the old milliner room. May 2 is on the shelf as type only.
